Liam Chen: Quick sync — vendor roadmap gap analysis. Need to align H100/H200/B200, MI300, Gaudi timelines + demo commitments for SI partners. Any availability for a short call tomorrow? Heads-up: potential embargo overlap for Gaudi early access.
Sofia Gomez: I can do 30m tomorrow 11:00am PT. Which vendors are we covering? NVIDIA, AMD, Habana?
Priya Rao: Yes. Also need to confirm which SKUs we'll promote in marketplace and whether any firmware/driver gates exist.
Jake Miller: Can partnerships get firm ETA weeks? We can't block the marketplace tags on vague Q3s. Also: any embargo dates from vendor PR teams?
Sofia Gomez: Vendor intel so far — NVIDIA: H100 restock tentatively mid-June; H200 limited in Q3. AMD MI300: staggered shipments starting July (vendor said rolling waves). Habana Gaudi: pilot access late June for select SI / integrators. B200: still unclear, vendor asked for SKU confirmation. All tentative.
Liam Chen: Action items: 1) Ask each vendor for 'ship week' (not just quarter). 2) Lock embargo windows with MarCom/PR. 3) Reserve demo slots for SI partners and internal demos. 4) Update marketplace SKU tagging doc and catalog flags. Who owns which?
Priya Rao: I'll own PR/embargo coordination with MarCom. Sofia — vendor ETAs + supply constraints. Jake — marketplace SKU tagging and catalog flags. Liam — demo calendar + SI invites.
Sofia Gomez: pinging vendor PDs now. I'll gather: ship week (ISO), supply constraints, firmware/driver blockers, required firmware image tags. Will report back by EOD.
calendar-bot: Event created: "Vendor roadmap sync — partnerships" Wed Jun 3 2026 11:00 PT — invitees: Liam Chen, Sofia Gomez, Priya Rao, Jake Miller
Jake Miller: Placeholder matrix until vendors confirm:
```
SKU        | Vendor  | Tentative ship week | Notes
H100       | NVIDIA  | 2026-06-15         | restock; validate kernel/driver
H200       | NVIDIA  | 2026-Q3(week TBD)  | limited
MI300      | AMD     | 2026-07-05         | staggered waves
Gaudi      | Habana  | 2026-06-25         | pilot SI access
B200       | TBD     | TBD                | need vendor confirmation
```
Liam Chen: Nice. Priya — when you have embargo windows, please loop in @Marcos for press cadence and confirm blackout dates. Also add fallback model-variant mappings to the marketplace doc (so we can auto-route to compatible variants during shortages).
Sofia Gomez: :thumbsup: Ping sent to vendor PDs — will update thread when replies come in.
